title: Bama Warwick and the first jazz cruise to Nassau
summary: He confirms Warwick was his Bordentown classmate and recalls the week-long cruise with Ray Charles, Oscar Peterson and James Moody.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: You mentioned back earlier that you had gone to school with and played in the same band with Carl Warwick.
You didn't mention whether it was at Bordentown.

Yes, it was Bordentown. 'Bama and I were classmates. And he happened to be one of the sponsors on the first Jazz cruise, the one from New York to Nassau and back. That's the one that was Dizzy Gillespie...
Yeah, I'm making piano playing signs. I'm thinking of Ray Charles. His band played on the ship, and Oscar Peterson, and...hmm, I'm making signs again.
You mentioned some of these artists before, but I can't remember who...

That's right, I mentioned them. Oh, James Moody. That's who I'm trying to think of. And so many beautiful people, you know, were on the ship, it was just really difficult to get around to see them all. But that was another joyful experience. A week on a ship with nothing but beautiful music.
There ought to be more of those. Yeah. They discontinued those for some reason.
